correctness.rationale: For a balanced connected three-vertex directed multigraph the BEST/Whittle rooted-word formula T(M)=n*tau*product_i(d_i-1)!/product_ij(m_ij)! correctly accounts for indistinguishable parallel arcs. The source handles nonprimitive pure repeated 2- and 3-cycles separately; for all other unique cases a unit-multiplicity edge forces primitivity and F=T/n=1. Loop multiplier binomial(r_i+a_i-1,a_i) and exact bowtie/theta F formulas classify <=4 cross-arcs; five-cross-arc lower bound >=2 and six-cross-arc arborescence lower bound >=3 exclude others. Sum of five disjoint support GFs gives the claimed rational function and leading n² term. Independent brute force grouped all 88,572 ternary words of lengths 1..10 by digram profile and necklace, reproducing coefficients 3,6,11,24,45,64,93,114,139,168; symbolic summation confirmed the rational identity. Enumeration is only corroboration: the support and primitivity arguments are the all-length proof.

value.rationale: Unique reconstruction from cyclic adjacent-pair statistics is a natural question in sequence assembly and Markov-type inversion. An exact labeled ternary all-length five-support classification, GF and quadratic growth degree give nontrivial structural information, not routine reparameterization of BEST or known binary tables.
